evidence.locator: D-Type national visa, What documents do I submit, travel medical insurance item
evidence.excerpt: Travel medical insurance with minimum coverage of 30 000 EUR, valid for the entire period of the requested national visa, covering all costs which may arise during the stay, related to any urgent medical assistance, emergency hospital treatment or repatriation for medical reasons as well as, in case of death, repatriation of the deceased.
